From 0c4eb2a6b3c6b0facd0a3bccda5db22e7b3b6f96 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Kishon Vijay Abraham I <kishon@ti.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Dec 2019 14:21:23 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] ARM: dts: am571x-idk: Fix gpios property to have the correct 
 gpio number

commit d23f3839fe97d8dce03d ("ARM: dts: DRA7: Add pcie1 dt node for
EP mode") while adding the dt node for EP mode for DRA7 platform,
added rc node for am571x-idk and populated gpios property with
"gpio3 23". However the GPIO_PCIE_SWRST line is actually connected
to "gpio5 18". Fix it here. (The patch adding "gpio3 23" was tested
with another am57x board in EP mode which doesn't rely on reset from
host).

Cc: stable <stable@vger.kernel.org> # 4.14+
Fixes: d23f3839fe97d8dce03d ("ARM: dts: DRA7: Add pcie1 dt node for EP mode")
Signed-off-by: Kishon Vijay Abraham I <kishon@ti.com>
Signed-off-by: Tony Lindgren <tony@atomide.com>

diff --git a/arch/arm/boot/dts/am571x-idk.dts b/arch/arm/boot/dts/am571x-idk.dts
index 67239f7c22b8..669559c9c95b 100644
--- a/arch/arm/boot/dts/am571x-idk.dts
+++ b/arch/arm/boot/dts/am571x-idk.dts
@@ -167,7 +167,7 @@ mbox_ipu2_ipc3x: mbox_ipu2_ipc3x {
 
 &pcie1_rc {
 	status = "okay";
-	gpios = <&gpio3 23 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;
+	gpios = <&gpio5 18 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;
 };
 
 &mmc1 {
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/arm/boot/dts/am571x-idk.dts`**
   - The `gpios` property under the `&pcie1_rc` node was modified:
     - Changed from `gpios = <&gpio3 23 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;` to `gpios = <&gpio5 18 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;`.

### Relationships

- The modification in the `am571x-idk.dts` file corrects a previous error introduced in commit `d23f3839fe97d8dce03d`, which incorrectly assigned the GPIO number for the `pcie1_rc` node. The patch ensures that the GPIO line connected to the reset signal is accurately represented, fixing the functionality for the am571x-idk platform. This change is essential for the correct operation of the PCIe interface on the device.

Here is the commit message:
ARM: dts: am571x-idk: Fix gpios property to have the correct 
 gpio number

commit d23f3839fe97d8dce03d ("ARM: dts: DRA7: Add pcie1 dt node for
EP mode") while adding the dt node for EP mode for DRA7 platform,
added rc node for am571x-idk and populated gpios property with
"gpio3 23". However the GPIO_PCIE_SWRST line is actually connected
to "gpio5 18". Fix it here. (The patch adding "gpio3 23" was tested
with another am57x board in EP mode which doesn't rely on reset from
host).

Cc: stable <stable@vger.kernel.org> # 4.14+
Fixes: d23f3839fe97d8dce03d ("ARM: dts: DRA7: Add pcie1 dt node for EP mode")
Signed-off-by: Kishon Vijay Abraham I <kishon@ti.com>
Signed-off-by: Tony Lindgren <tony@atomide.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by an incorrect assignment of the GPIO number in the device tree source file, where the GPIO line for the reset signal was mistakenly set to `gpio3 23` instead of the correct `gpio5 18`. This misconfiguration led to improper functionality of the PCIe interface on the am571x-idk platform.

Here is the patch:
 &pcie1_rc {
 	status = "okay";
-	gpios = <&gpio3 23 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;
+	gpios = <&gpio5 18 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;
 };

- `gpios = <&gpio3 23 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;`
Reason:
The GPIO line for the reset signal was incorrectly assigned to `gpio3 23`, which does not correspond to the actual hardware connection for the PCIe reset signal on the am571x-idk platform. This misconfiguration caused the PCIe interface to malfunction.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
- `gpios = <&gpio5 18 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;`
Reason:
The patch corrects the GPIO assignment by changing it to `gpio5 18`, which accurately reflects the hardware connection for the PCIe reset signal. This ensures proper functionality of the PCIe interface on the am571x-idk platform.
